All of British life is here in the new series of Tracey Ullman’s Show. Delinquent Dame Judi Dench is back, but will being a National Treasure be enough to save her this time? Nicola Sturgeon has her sights set on more than just Scotland....

The second episode sees the return of Camilla, Duchess of Cornwall who is shopping for cut price animal print leggings – or Jodhpurs as she prefers to call them. Its movie night in the Murdoch household.

programmes.d: Before Monty Python, before the Flying Circus, before America, the Hollywood Bowl and the hordes of fans, there were just six young men who came together with an idea for a show – a show that would transform their lives and change comedy forever.
This programme celebrates the 30th Anniversary of Monty Python's final film The Meaning of Life.
A pet-shop customer returns his dead parrot; a gang of female senior citizens attacks a town's young men; a young army officer who joined the service to water-ski tries to resign.
